D028 mirrors this with 'DRIVE AGX computing hardware, a reference sensor set... and an open, modular DRIVE software platform.' The subject is the specific hardware/software bundle of the DRIVE Hyperion platform.

comparisons.peer_summary: AMD's AI strategy is focused on three priorities: delivering a broad portfolio of high-performance adaptive hardware and software solutions, expanding ecosystem partnerships to accelerate deployments, and providing compelling user experiences via the open ROCm software platform.
comparisons.comparison: Both companies describe their AI hardware and software strategies in terms of providing a broad, integrated portfolio to accelerate adoption. NVIDIA highlights its 'complete end-to-end solution' under the DRIVE Hyperion brand for autonomous driving, consisting of hardware, sensors, and software. Similarly, AMD describes its AI strategy as delivering a 'broad portfolio of high-performance adaptive hardware and software solutions' and expanding ecosystem partnerships to accelerate deployments. While NVIDIA focuses on a specific automotive application (DRIVE Hyperion), AMD's disclosure is broader (general AI), but both emphasize the combination of high-performance hardware with an open software ecosystem to drive market adoption.

sentences.text: Leveraging our technology leadership in AI and building on our long-standing automotive relationships, we are delivering a complete end-to-end solution for the AV market under the DRIVE Hyperion brand.

DRIVE Hyperion consists of the high-performance, energy efficient DRIVE AGX computing hardware, a reference sensor set that supports full self-driving capability as well as an open, modular DRIVE software platform for autonomous driving, mapping, and parking services, and intelligent in-vehicle experiences.
The first is delivering a broad portfolio of high-performance adaptive hardware and software solutions.
The second is expanding the deep and collaborative partnerships we have established across the ecosystem to accelerate deployments of AMD based AI solutions at scale.
And the third is providing compelling user experiences to extend the open and proven software platform we have established that enables our AI hardware to be deployed more broadly and easily.
